name: Two personas — one hands the case to the other, and the first comes back

steps.intent: the first identity binds the primary browser — the label is written the way a sheet writes it, angle brackets and all. The URL is absolute on purpose: goto resolves against baseUrl, signIn.url does not
the page agrees about who is signed in, not merely that someone is

the hand-off: a second identity takes over. Through a catalog run it takes a browser of its own and nobody is signed out; through `run` there is no persona lane, so this is a sign-out and a fresh sign-in — the record says which
the second person sees the application as themselves
and the return: a switch with keptSession when each persona has a browser, a second login when they share one. Either way the identity is proved by the next step, never assumed
…which is provable only because the page names the account
